title: Mediated Auth Attestation
intent: Bind user-mediated authentication evidence to the exact acquisition request.
problem: Without external signature binds request fingerprint, actions and grant reference, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the mediated auth attestation contract.
context: This pattern addresses user must complete official authentication interaction; its concrete control is external signature binds request fingerprint, actions and grant reference.
forces: Correctness requires that gate holds verification key but no signing key
Operational pressure can cause: boolean approval is spoofed by the worker
solution: Implement external signature binds request fingerprint, actions and grant reference. Verify the anchored symbol `AuthGateError` with `test_complete_flow_stops_at_ready_to_report` before reuse.
invariants: gate holds verification key but no signing key
interactive actions exactly match the approved request
failure_modes: boolean approval is spoofed by the worker
attestation is replayed against another request
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `boolean approval is spoofed by the worker` and fails closed if the mediated auth attestation evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For mediated auth attestation, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to external signature binds request fingerprint, actions and grant reference.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: user must complete official authentication interaction
Do not apply when: public data requires no authenticated session
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
applies_when: user must complete official authentication interaction
not_when: public data requires no authenticated session
